goal: Ship v2.3.0: lift the type scale off the floor, give every calculation type an original illustration drawn from real computed data, and ship to production.

bars.name: Rowan
bars.role: Breadth + polish. ~13 molecular-modelling workflows, ~40 engines. Requires an account.

bars.name: MolCalc
bars.role: The true peer: free, zero sign-in, shared compute, <11 heavy atoms. Has frequencies, IR, thermochemistry, MOs — we have none of them.

measurable.name: NIST CCCBDB experimental fundamentals
measurable.rule: Our harmonic frequencies and thermochemistry must land inside a tolerance justified from the literature, or the round failed.
measurable.status: 10 molecules verified against NIST CCCBDB. Tolerance: scale harmonics by 0.97, then +/-4% relative or +/-50 cm-1 absolute, whichever is larger. Water and CO2 also carry experimental HARMONIC frequencies - those are compared unscaled.

constraints: Free Hugging Face Space: 2 vCPU / 16 GB / CPU only
No sign-in, ever — that is the product
Every cap must be a measured number, not a guess

pieces.name: Model catalog
pieces.detail: Expose every MACE foundation model the installed mace-torch really ships — with license, element coverage, theory level and measured cost.

rounds.gap: Rowan exposes ONE MACE model (MP-0b2 large); MolCalc has one method (PM3). We ship 4 levels of theory with licence on every result.

pieces.notes: 12 models / 7 families / 4 levels of theory. All 12 load and run.

pieces.name: Frequencies + thermochemistry
pieces.detail: Finite-difference Hessian, imaginary-mode diagnosis, ZPE, ideal-gas H/S/G, animatable normal modes.

rounds.gap: Beats MolCalc's PM3 decisively on accuracy and matches its feature list, EXCEPT IR intensities, which MACE cannot produce at all (no dipole in implemented_properties). We show an honest stick spectrum with null intensities; MolCalc keeps that one.

pieces.notes: H2O vs experimental HARMONIC: -1.02% / +0.33% / +0.16%. S=188.57 vs 188.83 J/mol/K (-0.14%).

pieces.name: Reaction paths
pieces.detail: Relaxed coordinate scan, climbing-image NEB, and IRC — or an honest refusal on IRC if it cannot be defended.

rounds.gap: Scan mechanics are exact (periodicity 0.0003 kcal/mol, constraint deviation 0.0000) but MACE-OFF23 systematically underestimates the barrier. Non-monotonic in model size. Reported, not hidden.

pieces.notes: Ethane torsion 2.487 kcal/mol vs 2.900 experimental (-14.2%, small). Medium -6.7%, large -9.4%.

pieces.name: Engine integration
pieces.detail: Wire the new modules into calculate.py without weakening its security boundary.

rounds.gap: phonon still refused, and correctly so - it is a different calculation, not a rename of vibrations.

pieces.notes: 7 calculation types live. Circular import broken via lazy forwarder. 5/5 validator, all module tests pass.

pieces.name: CPU budget guard
pieces.detail: Measured caps and honest refusals so an anonymous visitor cannot hang the shared Space.

rounds.gap: MolCalc caps at <11 heavy atoms. We reach 50 atoms and refuse honestly above it.

pieces.notes: MAX_ATOMS=50 for vibrations + dynamic per-structure gate; scan/NEB/IRC caps all measured.

pieces.name: Frontend: inputs
pieces.detail: Calculation-type and model pickers that make the new capability discoverable.

rounds.gap: Shows ASL non-commercial warning BEFORE the run - neither bar does this. Rowan still wins on breadth of workflows (13 vs our 7).

pieces.notes: Catalog-driven model picker with licence/theory/cost. NEB and phonon honestly disabled.

pieces.name: Frontend: results
pieces.detail: Stick spectrum, thermochemistry table, scan and NEB energy profiles, mode animation.

rounds.gap: Mode animation shipped. IR stick heights carry an explicit 'not intensities' annotation - MolCalc plots real PM3 intensities, we refuse to fake ours.

pieces.notes: Frequency table, stick spectrum (uniform height + on-chart honesty note), thermochem table, energy profiles, mode animation.

pieces.name: Mock + real scientific test
pieces.detail: Full mock pass over every route, then real MACE runs judged against CCCBDB.

rounds.gap: Mock test caught a real defect: every validation error returned HTTP 500. Now 400.

pieces.notes: Mock test: all 7 routes + 7 refusal paths. Real test: water/methane/ethane vs experiment. Full stack verified through Next route.

pieces.name: Deploy + live test
pieces.detail: Push to Vercel and run a real calculation against the live page.

rounds.gap: Live Space reproduces local numbers exactly. Preview is behind Vercel Deployment Protection so only the owner can open it; production not promoted.

pieces.notes: Space LIVE and verified (outage fixed). Vercel preview deployed; production promotion is the user’s call.

pieces.name: Type scale
pieces.detail: 40 of 58 text nodes measured at or below 12px, 17 of them at 10px. Scale moved up one step; all 113 hardcoded text-[Npx] literals folded onto it.
pieces.notes: Zero text below 13px. Zero hardcoded font sizes. No overflow at 375px or 1280px.

rounds.gap: Floor raised and hierarchy preserved, but 41 of 58 nodes now sit at 13px because the former 10px and 12px tiers collapsed together.

pieces.name: Calculation illustrations
pieces.detail: Seven original SVGs in the shape Rowan uses, but drawn from data this app actually produced.
pieces.notes: coordinate-scan plots the real 2.487 kcal/mol ethane barrier; vibrations uses water's real eigenvector and states no IR intensity exists.

rounds.gap: Beats Rowan on substance - theirs are decorative, ours are real measurements. phonon deliberately has no art.

pieces.name: Ship v2.3.0
pieces.detail: Full audit, then production deploy and a real scientific test against the live site.
pieces.notes: 13/13 audit checks pass. Live production: water frequencies within 0.96% of experimental harmonic, entropy within 0.14%.

rounds.gap: Audit found the Next route returned 500 for a bad modelType where the Python API returned 400. Both now 400.

log.msg: Ground truth established: mace-torch 0.3.15 exposes 17 mace_mp checkpoints, 3 mace_off, mace_anicc and mace_omol. The readthedocs page lists models this version does not have — mace_mdp and MACE-OFF24 are not offerable.
Five agents fanned out: two recon (bars, CCCBDB reference data), three builders (catalog, vibrations, reaction paths).

User set a 2M-token ceiling and a max of 2 concurrent tasks. Browser-recon agent killed (screenshot loops are the costliest per unit of insight); bar comparison now done from text sources. No further agents will be launched — remaining work runs inline.

CCCBDB set landed and I re-checked it myself: all 10 molecules pass degeneracy-weighted mode counting (3N-6/3N-5) and the ZPE = half-sum-of-fundamentals identity. Symmetry numbers independently correct (CH4=12, C6H6=12, C2H4=4, NH3=3).

No published MACE-OFF23-vs-experiment frequency MAE exists. Closest is Pracht et al. JCTC 2024: ZPVE MAE 0.22-0.23 kcal/mol vs a B3LYP-3c reference, not experiment. Our measurement will be the first honest one.
Model catalog integrated. 3 model families -> 7; 3 checkpoints -> 12. Results now carry level of theory and licence so a shared MACE Link says whether the number is ASL (non-commercial).

CLAUDE.md's MACE-OFF energy band (-100 to -600 eV/atom) was wrong and would mislabel water (-693.7). Corrected from measured checkpoint E0s. The validator code was already correct at -800/+100, so nothing shipped broken.

Water harmonic frequencies within 0.16-1.02% of experimental harmonic values; entropy within 0.14% of experiment. Ethane torsion barrier underestimated by 14% (small), 6.7% (medium), 9.4% (large) - non-monotonic in model size.

MACE cannot produce IR intensities: mace_mp()/mace_off() build MACECalculator without model_type, so 'dipole' is absent from implemented_properties and get_dipole_moment() raises. We return intensities:null with the reason quoted from source rather than plotting a fabricated spectrum.

Found the live site has been unable to run ANY calculation since 2026-08-10: the Space crashed on boot with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'provenance'. calculate.py imported it but it was never pushed to the Space repo, so Docker's COPY . . copied a build context missing the file.
Pushed mace-api/ to the Space including the missing provenance.py and the 3 new engine modules. Rebuilding now.

Space redeployed and verified end-to-end. Water vibrational analysis on the live free CPU Space: 1632.7/3845.7/3949.9 cm-1 (-0.96%/+0.35%/+0.19% vs experimental harmonic), S=188.57 J/mol/K (-0.14% vs experiment).

The first live call found a bug local testing could never reach: a float32 model left torch's process-global default dtype at float32, so the next request's float64 model ran under it and the Hessian guard correctly refused. Only reproduces in the long-lived FastAPI process. Fixed by forcing the global to match the dtype read back off the loaded model.
Live ethane torsion scan on the free Space: 2.487 kcal/mol, 13/13 points, constraint deviation 0.0, 6.1 s on 2 vCPU - identical to local.
Final sweep: 6/6 Python test files pass, validator 5/5, tsc clean, next build clean, live Space healthy serving 12 models.
Type scale lifted: text nodes at or below 12px went from 40/58 to 0. All 113 hardcoded text-[Npx] literals removed.
Seven original workflow illustrations authored - no external image fetched, copied or traced. Real computed data encoded in coordinate-scan and vibrations.
v2.3.0 deployed to production and aliased to mace-lake.vercel.app. Real test on live production: 1632.7/3845.7/3949.9 cm-1 (-0.96%/+0.35%/+0.19% vs experimental harmonic), S=188.57 J/mol/K (-0.14%).
